hints.content: A factor pair is $2$ whole numbers that we can multiply to get a certain product.

In this case, we are looking for pairs that have a product of $\greenE{42}$.  

$\begin{align}
1 \times 42 &= \greenE{42}\\\\
2 \times 21 &= \greenE{42}\\\\
3 \times 14 &= \greenE{42}\\\\
6 \times 7 &= \greenE{42}
\end{align}$

Here is the completed table:

First factor | | Second factor
:-: | - | :-:
$1$ | and | $42$
$2$ | and | $\blueE{21}$
$\blueE{3}$ | and | $14$
$6$ | and | $\blueE{7}$
